items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
items.summary: 该项目将 Andrej Karpathy 关于大语言模型编程常见陷阱的观察提炼成一个 CLAUDE.md 文件，用于优化 Claude Code 的行为。它通过编码最佳实践（如避免过早优化、确保显式错误处理）充当系统提示，引导模型生成更安全、更可靠的代码。开发者只需将此文件放入项目根目录，即可立即改善 Claude 的代码生成质量。这是一个轻量级但实用的工具，适合所有使用 LLM 辅助编程的开发者，帮助他们避免常见错误，提升代码质量。
items.summary_en: This project distills Andrej Karpathy's insights on common LLM coding pitfalls into a single CLAUDE.md file that guides Claude Code to produce better outputs. By encoding best practices like avoiding premature optimization and ensuring explicit error handling, it acts as a system prompt for safer, more reliable code generation. Developers can drop this file into any project to instantly improve Claude's behavior, making it a practical tool for anyone using LLM-assisted coding.

items.name: LLMs-from-scratch
items.summary: LLMs-from-scratch 是一个教育性开源项目，通过从零实现类ChatGPT大语言模型，帮助开发者深入理解LLM的工作原理。项目采用PyTorch和Jupyter Notebook逐步讲解Transformer架构、注意力机制等核心概念，让学习者亲手搭建完整模型。这种实践方式不仅揭示了LLM内部机制，还提供了可修改的代码基础，开发者可在此基础上调整模型结构、训练自己的语言模型，或将其作为学习深度学习和自然语言处理的实践平台。
items.summary_en: LLMs-from-scratch is an educational project that demystifies large language models by guiding users through building a ChatGPT-like model from the ground up. It teaches core concepts like transformer architecture and attention mechanisms through hands-on PyTorch implementation in Jupyter notebooks. Developers can use it to understand LLM internals, experiment with model components, and build custom language applications by modifying the provided codebase.

items.name: How-To-Secure-A-Linux-Server
items.summary: 这是一份不断更新的 Linux 服务器安全加固实战指南，旨在帮助用户系统性地防范常见攻击。它从基础配置讲起，逐步深入到 SSH 密钥认证、防火墙规则、入侵检测等高级主题。其最大优势在于提供可直接复制执行的命令和清晰的解释，让安全配置不再神秘。无论是部署新服务器还是审计现有环境，你都可以将其作为检查清单，按步骤操作，显著提升系统安全性。
items.summary_en: This guide provides a comprehensive, step-by-step approach to hardening a Linux server against common threats. It covers everything from initial setup to advanced configurations like SSH key authentication, firewall rules, and intrusion detection. The strength lies in its practical, copy-paste-ready commands and clear explanations, making security accessible even to beginners. Use it as a checklist for new servers or as a reference to audit and improve existing setups.

items.name: scientific-agent-skills
items.summary: Scientific Agent Skills 是一套即用型智能体技能集合，专为科研、工程、分析、金融和写作场景设计。它将复杂任务拆解为模块化、可组合的技能单元，如文献综述、数据分析、报告生成等，使AI智能体能自动完成多步骤工作流。核心设计理念强调复用性与易集成性，开发者无需从零构建，只需组合预置技能即可快速定制智能体。例如，在药物发现中，可串联化学信息学、基因组学与临床研究技能，实现从靶点筛选到报告输出的全流程自动化。该工具旨在降低智能体开发门
items.summary_en: Scientific Agent Skills is a collection of ready-to-use agent skills for research, science, engineering, analysis, finance, and writing. It provides modular, composable skills that can be plugged into AI agents to automate complex workflows, such as literature review, data analysis, and report generation. The project emphasizes reusability and ease of integration, allowing users to quickly build custom agents by combining pre-built skills. Practitioners can use these skills to accelerate scientific discovery, streamline data analysis, or automate routine tasks in drug discovery and genomics.

items.name: telegraf
items.summary: Telegraf 是一个插件驱动的服务器代理，用于收集、处理、聚合和写入指标、日志及其他数据。其核心优势在于模块化架构，提供超过300种输入、输出和处理插件，无需编码即可构建灵活的数据管道。技术亮点包括支持多种协议（如MQTT、Modbus、OPC UA）和格式（JSON、Kafka），以及内置的聚合与过滤功能。你可以用它监控服务器基础设施、物联网设备或应用性能：只需配置输入插件（如CPU、Docker或Kubernetes）和输出插件（如InfluxDB、Prometheus或Elasticsearch），即可快速搭建端到端的监控系统。
items.summary_en: Telegraf is a plugin-driven server agent for collecting, processing, aggregating, and writing metrics, logs, and other data. Its key strength is a modular architecture with over 300 input, output, and processor plugins, enabling flexible data pipelines without coding. Use it to monitor infrastructure, IoT devices, or application performance by configuring plugins for sources like Kafka, MQTT, or Modbus and outputs like InfluxDB or Prometheus.

items.name: supertonic
items.summary: Supertonic 是一款轻量级、设备端运行的多语言文本转语音引擎，通过 ONNX 实现原生推理，无需云端依赖即可快速合成语音，保障用户隐私。其核心技术优势在于对 ONNX 运行时的深度优化，在 iOS、Android 及桌面端均能实现低延迟推理。开发者可利用其提供的 Swift、Python、Rust 等多语言绑定，轻松集成到离线语音助手、无障碍工具或语言学习应用中，让设备在无网络环境下也能流畅发声。
items.summary_en: Supertonic is a lightweight, on-device multilingual text-to-speech engine that runs natively via ONNX, enabling fast, privacy-preserving speech synthesis without cloud dependencies. Its core strength lies in optimized ONNX runtime integration, delivering low-latency inference across iOS, Android, and desktop platforms. Developers can integrate it into apps for offline voice assistants, accessibility tools, or language learning, leveraging pre-built bindings for Swift, Python, Rust, and more.

items.name: brush
items.summary: Brush 是一款开源 3D 重建工具，旨在让高斯泼溅技术（Gaussian Splatting）人人可用。它基于 Rust 引擎，通过 GPU 加速优化，将照片或视频高效转化为高质量 3D 场景。技术亮点在于将复杂的 3D 高斯泼溅流程简化为直观操作，无需专业背景即可上手。你可以用它扫描真实物体或环境，导出用于 AR/VR、游戏或可视化项目。无论是爱好者还是专业人士，都能快速获得高保真 3D 模型，探索创意应用。
items.summary_en: Brush is an open-source 3D reconstruction tool that makes Gaussian Splatting accessible to everyone. It uses a Rust-based engine to efficiently convert photos or videos into high-quality 3D scenes, leveraging GPU-accelerated optimization. Technically, it simplifies the complex pipeline of 3D Gaussian Splatting into a user-friendly interface. You can use it to capture real-world objects or environments and export them for AR/VR, gaming, or visualization projects. Ideal for hobbyists and professionals seeking fast, high-fidelity 3D scanning without deep expertise.

items.name: GTweak
items.summary: GTweak是一款便携式Windows系统优化工具，通过一键式操作实现系统精简、性能提升与隐私保护。它利用注册表调整、禁用非必要服务（如Windows Defender、OneDrive）及阻止遥测数据收集，打造更干净、快速的Windows环境。技术层面集成KMS激活、HWID伪装和系统监控功能，所有操作通过图形界面完成，无需手动修改注册表。支持U盘携带，重装系统后可快速应用或撤销优化配置。适合IT管理员及高级用户，可禁用Cortana、移除预装应用、关闭自动更新，显著提升老旧设备响应速度。
items.summary_en: GTweak is a portable Windows utility that simplifies system optimization and debloating, helping users achieve a cleaner, faster, and more private setup. It leverages registry tweaks, service disabling, and telemetry blocking to remove unnecessary components like Windows Defender or OneDrive. Technically, it combines KMS activation, HWID spoofing, and monitoring tools in one GUI. You can run it from a USB drive to quickly configure a fresh Windows install or revert changes, making it ideal for IT pros or power users building streamlined systems.

items.name: acton
items.summary: Acton 是一个基于 Rust 的 TON 区块链智能合约开发工具链，旨在解决 TON 开发中工具链复杂、入门门槛高的问题。其核心创新在于将高级语言 Tolk 与 Rust 工具链深度集成，提供高效的编译、测试和部署能力。开发者可以利用 Acton 编写智能合约，借助 Rust 的性能和安全性进行编译和调试，并一键部署到 TON 网络。它特别适合构建 DeFi 应用、NFT 或自定义代币，无论是新手还是经验丰富的区块链工程师，都能通过 Acton 简化开发流程，快速将想法落地为链上应用。
items.summary_en: Acton is a Rust-based toolchain that streamlines TON blockchain smart contract development, addressing the complexity of building on TON. Its key innovation is integrating Tolk, a high-level language, with Rust tooling for efficient compilation and testing. Developers can use Acton to write, compile, and deploy contracts, leveraging Rust's performance and safety. Ideal for building DeFi apps, NFTs, or custom tokens on TON, it simplifies the workflow for both newcomers and experienced blockchain engineers.

items.name: multilingual-e5-small
items.summary: multilingual-e5-small 是一个轻量级多语言文本嵌入模型，能将句子转换为稠密向量，用于语义搜索和检索。它基于 E5 架构的蒸馏版本，通过 ONNX 和 Transformers.js 优化，可在浏览器或 Node.js 中直接运行，实现客户端推理。其核心优势在于以极小模型体积保持出色的跨语言性能，特别适合多语言文档搜索、聊天机器人知识检索等实时应用场景，无需服务器成本即可快速部署。
items.summary_en: multilingual-e5-small is a compact, multilingual text embedding model that converts sentences into dense vectors for semantic search and retrieval. It uses a distilled version of the E5 architecture, optimized for efficiency with ONNX and Transformers.js, enabling client-side inference in browsers or Node.js. Its key strength is balancing strong cross-lingual performance with a small footprint, making it ideal for real-time applications like multilingual document search or chatbot retrieval without server costs.

items.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF
items.summary: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 是一个混合专家（MoE）视觉语言模型，总参数量35B，但每次推理仅激活3B参数，大幅降低计算成本。它同时处理图像和文本，擅长视觉问答、文档理解等多模态任务。通过GGUF量化，模型可在普通消费级GPU甚至CPU上运行，配合llama.cpp或Ollama即可本地部署。适合构建离线AI助手、智能相册或文档分析工具，在隐私敏感场景中尤为实用。
items.summary_en: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) vision-language model that activates only 3B of its 35B parameters per token, achieving high efficiency. It excels at understanding both images and text, enabling tasks like visual question answering and document analysis. The GGUF quantization makes it deployable on consumer hardware via llama.cpp or Ollama, ideal for local AI assistants or edge applications.

items.name: Qwen3Guard-Gen-0.6B
items.summary: Qwen3Guard-Gen-0.6B 是基于 Qwen3-0.6B 微调的轻量级安全护栏模型，专用于检测和拦截大语言模型生成的有害内容。其核心技术是在基础模型上添加轻量分类头，实现高效实时过滤，无需大量计算资源。可部署为独立内容安全过滤器或集成至 LLM 流程，适用于聊天机器人、内容审核及需严格安全机制的 AI 助手等场景，帮助开发者快速增强系统安全防护。
items.summary_en: Qwen3Guard-Gen-0.6B is a compact safety guardrail model fine-tuned from Qwen3-0.6B, designed to detect and block harmful or unsafe content in LLM outputs. Its key technical insight is using a lightweight classifier head on top of the base model, enabling efficient real-time filtering without heavy compute. You can deploy it as a standalone content safety filter or integrate it into your LLM pipeline to intercept toxic responses, making it ideal for chatbots, content moderation, and AI assistants requiring robust safety measures.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是一种基于判别式预训练的Transformer模型，通过将掩码语言建模改为区分真实与生成器产生的替代标记，显著提升训练效率。其核心创新是使用小型生成器产生替代标记，再由判别器识别真假，比BERT等模型训练更快且性能强劲。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调该模型，应用于文本分类、命名实体识别或问答任务，特别适合计算资源有限但需要高质量语言理解的场景。

items.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。
items.summary_en: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 is a compact BERT-based model optimized for text ranking and semantic search tasks, solving the challenge of efficient information retrieval from large text collections. It employs knowledge distillation to compress a larger teacher model into a smaller arc…
